item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi 'jigs tshogs bzlog pa'i zor mdos
item.coloph: de ltar 'jigs tshogs bzlog (zlog) pa'i las (tshogs) 'di/ 'gro la sman phyir 'chi med bdag gis spros/ bka' yi gnyer dpon g.yung drung gsal 'bar sogs/ grub pa'i gshen la gtar ro (gtad do) gces par bzung (zungs/)skabs zhig bon chos bstan pa sbas tshul du/ sa 'og gter du gshegs pa'i dus shar tshe/ brda ris bris te rtse drug byang nub 'tshams (mtshams/)brag dmar bam tshogs gsham (bsham) 'drar gter du sbas so/ gter bdag dam can rnams bya ra gzob(gzobs //) phyis su bdag 'dra gshen sprul pas phug leb 'o ma stag rtse'i brag nas rnyed te (de) bka' rgya gdab/ hor sras rin po che sogs/ las ldan du mas bskul ngor / shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//
